answers.core: This is a user education issue. Users who are unaware of the problem will not install an add-on to fix it.
answers.workaround: This problem is trivial to avoid if you are aware of its existence before publishing a project. Changing the package name after the fact requires all existing mobile users to reinstall the app, losing their user:// data.

title: Encourage setting a "unique name" at project creation to simplify Android/iOS export for first-time users.
